subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack agents receive workspace-wide `channel-list` plus per-ID `channel-info`, and which channel-policy and action-gating rules should govern discovery?
rationale: The plugin can implement both Slack APIs, but current behavior does not establish whether token-visible conversations may all be disclosed, whether configured channel policy filters discovery, or whether listing deserves a separate opt-in setting.

options.title: Policy-filtered discovery
options.body: Expose both actions through the existing `channelInfo` gate and return only conversations allowed by the configured Slack channel policy.

options.title: Token-visible discovery
options.body: Expose every conversation visible to the selected Slack token behind an explicit, separately approved listing gate.

options.title: Channel lookup only
options.body: Add per-ID `channel-info` now and defer workspace enumeration until maintainers define its disclosure contract.

recommendation.title: Policy-filtered discovery
recommendation.body: Expose both actions through the existing `channelInfo` gate and return only conversations allowed by the configured Slack channel policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work covers the Slack action runtime, configuration, authorization, documentation, and related feature-parity direction.
